about_the_game:
The Fling with a Tiefling Original Soundtrack (Extended) is composed by the wonderfully talented Scented Scarlett. This soundtrack contains six tracks; three of which are from the original title and three that are brand new, never before-heard compositions!

This soundtrack includes .OGG and .WAV files!

How to Access

1) After installing the soundtrack, go to your library and right click on "Fling with a Tiefling Soundtrack."

2) Click "Properties"

3) Go to "Installed Files" and click on "Browse...". This should take you to the soundtrack folder. Click on it and you'll find the music file types!
